## <span style="color:  #2D4947;"> `r fontawesome::fa("user", fill = "#2D4947", prefer_type="solid")` Bio</span>
<br>
I am currently attending Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health as a Master of Science Candidate in the Department of Biostatistics. I aim to build a more robust skill set in study design and statistical data analysis in pursuit of a higher level career in clinical and public health research.

I previously worked for two years as a Staff Research Associate in the Department of Pediatrics at UC Davis Health where I coordinated studies and projects for the Diabetes Research Team in Pediatric Endocrinology, and gained well-rounded knowledge in clinical research protocol, regulations, and practices. It was there where I solidified my passion for research and sparked my interest in biostatistics.
